title: The scalar-and-size tensor comparison respects coefficient towers
statement:
Let $F,G,H,\Omega$ be fields. Let $\varphi:F\to G$, $\psi:G\to H$,
$\theta:F\to H$, $\xi:F\to\Omega$, $\eta:G\to\Omega$, and
$\chi:H\to\Omega$ be field homomorphisms such that
$\psi\varphi=\theta$, $\eta\varphi=\xi$, $\chi\psi=\eta$, and
$\chi\theta=\xi$. Write $F_\varphi:D(F)\to D(G)$ for derived scalar
extension and $A_\xi:D(F)\to D(\Omega)$ for scalar-and-size extension.
Let $c(\varphi,\psi,\theta):F_\varphi\circ F_\psi\simeq F_\theta$
and $p(\varphi,\eta,\xi):F_\varphi\circ A_\eta\simeq A_\xi$
be the generic canonical comparisons constructed in
[def-weil-frobenius-cohomology-comparison-factors], with the displayed equalities
inserted. For every $V\in D(F)$ one has
$$
 A_\chi(c(\varphi,\psi,\theta)_V);p(\theta,\chi,\xi)_V
 =p(\psi,\chi,\eta)_{F_\varphi V};p(\varphi,\eta,\xi)_V.
$$
Semicolons and functor composites are written in diagram order. This scalar law
is independent of geometry, cohomology, finite coefficient stages and algebraic
closure assumptions. The finite-stage law is its specialization to the recorded
coefficient inclusions and stage embeddings.
Equivalently, as natural isomorphisms, (c whiskered by A_H);p_FH equals
associator;(F_FG whiskered with p_GH);p_FG. The component equation proves this
isomorphism equality by extensionality.

source.place: (1.1.1)(d), canonical iterated coefficient extension, and (1.1.14), ordinary and compact cohomology; explicit factor of Steps 1--2 of the parent proof.

proof.text: Precompose the ordinary module equation by the invertible field tensor associator. Two tensor inductions reduce the comparison to a tensor a tensor b tensor m, with a in Omega and b in N. The field associator inserts the scalar one in L. The normalization of frobeniusCoefficientModulesTower_existsUnique sends both routes to a times the image of b, tensored with m; multiplication by the image of one changes nothing. Cancelling the precomposed isomorphism proves the ordinary module identity.

Apply the ordinary identity degreewise to complexes. On a complex representative, mapDerivedCategoryCompIso_fac and mapDerivedCategoryNatIso_fac identify the induced maps after the specified factorization isomorphisms. The fieldScalarTower normalization is the same ordinary balanced tensor map. Naturality moves each factorization isomorphism past the intermediate comparison; inverse pairs cancel. Essential surjectivity of derived localization extends the identity from complex representatives to every V.

Apply equality induction to the four equalities of field homomorphisms. This reduces the statement to the composable tower with theta equal to psi composed with phi, eta equal to chi composed with psi, and xi equal to eta composed with phi. Proof irrelevance identifies the remaining equality proof with reflexivity. Unfold the two generic comparison constructors and cancel the identity eqToIso factors. The preceding derived tensor identity is exactly the resulting equation.

Apply extensionality for natural isomorphisms and natural transformations to obtain the natural-isomorphism cocycle from the proved component identity. Simplify the identity components of the functor associator. This gives the same tensor law before any specialization to a family of fields.

proof_origin.place: G1: complete generic Lean proof by balanced-tensor normalization, factorization on cochain complexes, and derived localization. Equality induction inserts arbitrary specified equalities of the field maps. Finite-stage coherence is a specialization.

theorem coefficientComparison_cocycle
    {F G H : Type u} [Field F] [Field G] [Field H] {Ω : Type v} [Field Ω]
    (φ : F →+* G) (ψ : G →+* H) (θ : F →+* H)
    (ξ : F →+* Ω) (η : G →+* Ω) (χ : H →+* Ω)
    (hcomp : ψ.comp φ = θ) (hφ : η.comp φ = ξ) (hψ : χ.comp ψ = η)
    (hθ : χ.comp θ = ξ)
    (V : @DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} F) _ _
      (HasDerivedCategory.ofIsGrothendieckAbelian.{u} _)) :
    letI : HasDerivedCategory.{u} (ModuleCat.{u} F) :=
      HasDerivedCategory.ofIsGrothendieckAbelian _
    letI : HasDerivedCategory.{u} (ModuleCat.{u} G) :=
      HasDerivedCategory.ofIsGrothendieckAbelian _
    letI : HasDerivedCategory.{u} (ModuleCat.{u} H) :=
      HasDerivedCategory.ofIsGrothendieckAbelian _
    letI : HasDerivedCategory.{(max u v) + 1} (ModuleCat.{max u v} Ω) :=
      HasDerivedCategory.standard _
    (frobeniusCohomologyCoefficientExtension χ).map
        ((scalarAssociator φ ψ θ hcomp).hom.app V) ≫
        (coefficientRingComparison θ χ ξ hθ).hom.app V =
      (coefficientRingComparison ψ χ η hψ).hom.app
          ((DerivedCategory.fieldDerivedScalarExtension φ).obj V) ≫
        (coefficientRingComparison φ η ξ hφ).hom.app V
